name: @nextrap/style-utils
description: Nextrap semantic surface and local color-scheme utility classes.

classes.name: surface-primary
classes.description: Set background to --nt-primary and foreground to --nt-text-on-primary. Use for readable primary-colored sections, heroes, callouts, cards or controls.

classes.name: surface-secondary
classes.description: Set background to --nt-secondary and foreground to --nt-text-on-secondary. Use for readable secondary semantic surfaces.

classes.name: surface-tertiary
classes.description: Set background to --nt-tertiary and foreground to --nt-text-on-tertiary. Use for readable tertiary semantic surfaces.

classes.name: surface-accent
classes.description: Set background to --nt-accent and foreground to --nt-text-on-accent. Use for readable accent/highlight surfaces.

classes.name: surface-success
classes.description: Set background to --nt-success and foreground to --nt-text-on-success. Use for readable positive/status surfaces.

classes.name: surface-info
classes.description: Set background to --nt-info and foreground to --nt-text-on-info. Use for readable informational surfaces.

classes.name: surface-warning
classes.description: Set background to --nt-warning and foreground to --nt-text-on-warning. Use for readable warning surfaces.

classes.name: surface-danger
classes.description: Set background to --nt-danger and foreground to --nt-text-on-danger. Use for readable destructive/error surfaces.

classes.name: surface-light
classes.description: Set an explicit light background and its matching contrast foreground. Use when a section should stay visually light regardless of the surrounding page.

classes.name: surface-dark
classes.description: Set an explicit dark background and its matching contrast foreground. Use for inverted dark sections without changing the whole descendant color-scheme.

classes.name: surface-white
classes.description: Set an explicit white background and matching contrast foreground.

classes.name: surface-black
classes.description: Set an explicit black background and matching contrast foreground.

classes.name: scheme-light
classes.description: Force color-scheme: light on this element and its descendant subtree. Use when all scheme-aware tokens/components inside a local section should evaluate in light mode.

classes.name: scheme-dark
classes.description: Force color-scheme: dark on this element and its descendant subtree. Use for locally inverted sections whose light-dark() tokens and native controls should all evaluate in dark mode.
